title: Evaluation for finite locally free module sheaves
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and let $\mathcal F$ be a finite locally free $\mathcal O_X$-module: there is an open cover $(V_a)$ of $X$ such that $\mathcal F|_{V_a}\cong\mathcal O_{V_a}^{\oplus d_a}$ for integers $d_a\geq0$ (compare the constant-rank notion of [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]). For every $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal G$, the canonical evaluation morphism $\mathcal F^{\vee}\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal G\to\mathcal{H}om_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal F,\mathcal G)$, where $\mathcal F^{\vee}:=\mathcal{H}om_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal F,\mathcal O_X)$, is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_X$-modules, natural in $\mathcal G$. Here tensor product, sheaf Hom, its group of global sections, and sheaves of modules use [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], [def-pur-sheaf-hom], [def-pur-sheaf-modules-hom-module], and [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category].
